title: Python repository-shaped regression validation
purpose: Challenge Python private-function reference evidence with realistic package/import topology before expanding language coverage.
entry_condition: M08 is accepted on main and Python 3.13 is provisioned in CI.

transitions.action: Run the 14-case repository-shaped Python corpus and preserve exact FP/FN evidence.
Repair only source-layout aliases, direct re-export forwarding, usage/liveness separation, and dotted-module isolation.
Require M07/M08/M09 plus all accepted public/labeled real-world matrices on Linux, Windows, and macOS.
Synchronize strict governance and prepare immediate PR promotion to main.

invariants: M07 and M08 accepted Python behavior must remain passing.
Import/export liveness evidence never becomes safe-delete proof.
One-use BLOAT evidence counts usage separately from declarative import/export liveness.
Unresolved attribute fallback cannot keep multiple same-named candidates alive.
Every accepted real-world matrix runs on both main and work/**.
failure_behavior: Any corpus FP/FN, prior-gate regression, real-world matrix failure, parse incompleteness, or strict governance drift blocks M09 promotion.
restart_behavior: All fixture roots and exact public repository pins are deterministic and rerunnable.
rollback_behavior: M09 topology repair can be reverted to main@29924f324db316a9a2985943c09d4711824a1220 without changing external source evidence.
